Aisha (People Ops): Quick update on the upcoming performance cycle — timeline tweaks and calibration ops below. Please read and RSVP asap :calendar:

Aisha (People Ops): Key dates: self-review window Apr 6-10, manager writeups due Apr 17 COB, calibration week Apr 20-24 (compact 30-min panels). Managers, sign up for a panel slot and indicate any delegates.

Aisha (People Ops): New for this cycle — compact calibration: 30-min focused panels by org cluster (no more 60-mins). We expect to surface edge cases ahead of time using the manager prep form.

Aisha (People Ops): RSVP here (required for managers): https://go.redwood/hr/review-2026-rsvp — include: team, preferred slot, backup delegate, panel attendees.

Aisha (People Ops): Prep checklist (one-pager):
- fill manager_calib_prep.md (link in doc hub)
- attach 3 exemplar prompts for quality/regression concerns
- flag any cross-team calibration items by Apr 13

Sam (eng): Got it — I can take Tue Apr 21 2:30pm slot. Will add substitute if conflict.

Priya (eng): Can do Wed morning (Apr 22 9:00-9:30). Who should I list as panel attendees?

Diego (manager): I'll be on Thu Apr 23 AM. Quick Q: are skip-levels expected to attend?

Aisha (People Ops): Skip-levels optional. Prefer the direct manager + one peer reviewer. If you want skip-level context for calibration edge cases, note that on the form.

Marcus (hr-ops): Reminder: manager writeups must use the new scoring rubric v2 (link). We will normalize scores in calibration using the rubric matrix.

Priya (eng): Thanks — where's the manager prep template?

Aisha (People Ops): manager prep template: https://go.redwood/docs/manager_calib_prep.md  Example snippet:
```
Team: Platform
Top 3 impacts:
- Reduced inference latency by 18% via batching
Potential concerns:
- Small sample size for recent rollout
Suggested calibration note: consider effort vs impact
```

Sam (eng): Will attach two examples from my direct reports.

Diego (manager): If I can't make my slot, can I delegate to my EM?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes. Add delegate name + contact in the RSVP. Calibration panels will accept 1 delegate per manager.

hr-bot: Automated reminder — managers who have not completed the RSVP form will receive a DM 72h before calibration week.

Priya (eng): Small ask — can we get a shared calendar with all confirmed slots? Makes it easier to coordinate.

Aisha (People Ops): Yep — I'll publish the calendar by EOD Friday. Calendar invite example (use when creating invites):
```
Subject: Calibration — Platform cluster
When: Apr 21 14:30-15:00 PDT
Guests: Aisha, Sam, Priya, Diego
Location: Zoom (link auto-generated)
Agenda: 1) quick context 2) score proposals 3) edge cases + notes
```

Sam (eng): Sounds good. Thanks Aisha :thumbsup: 

Marcus (hr-ops): Final note — if you have cross-team disputes, flag them by Apr 13 and we'll slot a cross-org panel.

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks everyone — please complete the RSVP and prep template by Apr 13 so calibration runs smoothly. Ping me or @Marcus if anything blocks. :eyes:
